quote: A mermaid is a mythical sea-dwelling creature, often described as having the head and body of a woman and a fish's tail below the waist.

statement.id: Putri duyung adalah makhluk laut mitis berkepala dan bertubuh atas perempuan serta berekor ikan.
statement.en: A mermaid is a mythical sea being with a woman's upper body and a fish tail.

quote: Stories of mermaids have existed for thousands of years and span cultures across the world

statement.id: Cerita putri duyung tersebar di berbagai budaya dunia.
statement.en: Mermaid stories span cultures around the world.

quote: In some cultures, the mermaid signifies life and fertility within the ocean. In others, she embodies the destructive nature of the water, luring sailors to their deaths

statement.id: Sebagian tradisi mengaitkan putri duyung dengan kesuburan laut, sebagian lain dengan bahaya bagi pelaut.
statement.en: Some traditions link mermaids to sea fertility and others to danger for sailors.

quote: Southeast Asian folklore includes the story of a mermaid princess, Suvannamaccha

statement.id: Cerita Asia Tenggara mengenal putri duyung Suvannamaccha.
statement.en: Southeast Asian tales include the mermaid princess Suvannamaccha.

quote: In early Greek mythology, the sirens were half-women, half-bird creatures and are often confused with mermaids.
locator: Difference between a siren and a mermaid

statement.id: Siren Yunani awal berwujud perempuan dan burung, tetapi kerap tertukar dengan putri duyung.
statement.en: Early Greek sirens were woman-bird beings often confused with mermaids.

quote: Sightings of dugongs, a member of the manatee’s order, have also been associated with mermaids throughout history.

statement.id: Laporan penampakan dugong pernah dikaitkan dengan putri duyung.
statement.en: Reported dugong sightings have been associated with mermaids.

quote: In folklore, a mermaid is an aquatic creature with the head and upper body of a female human and the tail of a fish.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat putri duyung memiliki tubuh atas perempuan dan ekor ikan.
statement.en: Folkloric mermaids have a woman's upper body and fish tail.

quote: one of the heroes, Hanuman attempts to build a bridge of stones across the sea.

statement.id: Kisah Suvannamaccha melibatkan Hanuman yang hendak membangun jembatan batu melintasi laut.
statement.en: Suvannamaccha’s tale involves Hanuman trying to build a stone bridge across the sea.

quote: The English word mermaid is a compound of "mere" (Old English for sea) and "maid" (a girl or young woman).

statement.id: Kata Inggris "mermaid" adalah gabungan "mere" (bahasa Inggris Kuno untuk laut) dan "maid" (gadis atau perempuan muda).
statement.en: The English word mermaid is a compound of "mere" (Old English for sea) and "maid" (a girl or young woman).

quote: While mermaids are morally ambiguous creatures, sirens were said to be always malicious and dangerous
locator: What is the difference between a siren and a mermaid?

statement.id: Putri duyung adalah makhluk yang secara moral ambigu, sedangkan siren dikatakan selalu jahat dan berbahaya.
statement.en: Mermaids are morally ambiguous creatures, whereas sirens were said to be always malicious and dangerous.

quote: In sailor folklore, mermaids represent both good fortune and disaster.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat pelaut, putri duyung melambangkan keberuntungan sekaligus bencana.
statement.en: In sailor folklore, mermaids represent both good fortune and disaster.

quote: While many different decorations have been used, mermaids proved popular with the sailors as they were believed to appease the sea, ensuring good weather and finding a safe way back to land.

statement.id: Putri duyung populer di kalangan pelaut sebagai hiasan haluan kapal karena dipercaya menenangkan laut, menjamin cuaca baik, dan menemukan jalan aman kembali ke daratan.
statement.en: Mermaids proved popular with sailors as decorations on ships because they were believed to appease the sea, ensuring good weather and a safe way back to land.

quote: A famous Greek folktale claimed that Alexander the Great's sister, Thessalonike was transformed into a mermaid upon her death in 295 BC and lived in the Aegean sea.
locator: Ancient Greece and Rome: Sirens and Mermaids

statement.id: Sebuah cerita rakyat Yunani menyebut Thessalonike, saudari Alexander Agung, diubah menjadi putri duyung setelah meninggal pada 295 SM dan hidup di Laut Aegea.
statement.en: A famous Greek folktale claimed that Thessalonike, sister of Alexander the Great, was transformed into a mermaid upon her death in 295 BC and lived in the Aegean sea.

quote: Any other answer was said to anger her, and she would conjure a storm and doom the vessel and its sailors to a death at sea.
locator: Ancient Greece and Rome: Sirens and Mermaids

statement.id: Jawaban selain yang benar dikatakan membuatnya marah, dan ia akan memunculkan badai yang membinasakan kapal dan para pelautnya di laut.
statement.en: Any other answer was said to anger her, and she would conjure a storm and doom the vessel and its sailors to death at sea.

quote: In West, South and Central Africa, a range of tales exist about mythical water spirits called Mami Wata (meaning "Water as Mother" or "Mother of the Waters").

statement.id: Di Afrika Barat, Selatan, dan Tengah ada berbagai kisah tentang roh air mitos bernama Mami Wata ("Air sebagai Ibu" atau "Ibu Perairan").
statement.en: In West, South and Central Africa, a range of tales exist about mythical water spirits called Mami Wata ("Water as Mother" or "Mother of the Waters").

quote: The spirit is worshipped for both their benevolence in offering beauty, healing and wisdom, and as a way of warding off natural disasters.

statement.id: Roh itu dipuja karena kebaikannya yang memberi kecantikan, penyembuhan, dan kebijaksanaan, serta sebagai cara menangkal bencana alam.
statement.en: The spirit is worshipped for its benevolence in offering beauty, healing and wisdom, and as a way of warding off natural disasters.

quote: Often translated as "mermaid," the Rusalki are water nymphs of Slavic mythology. While initially regarded as benevolent spirits of fertility and agriculture, Rusalki gained a more sinister description in the 1800s. They were believed to be the ghosts of women who died violent deaths by drowning. In their anger and sorrow, the Rusalki now lured men and children to their watery graves.

statement.id: Rusalki, nimfa air dalam mitologi Slavia, sering diterjemahkan sebagai "putri duyung"; semula dianggap roh kesuburan dan pertanian yang baik, tetapi pada tahun 1800-an digambarkan lebih jahat, sebagai hantu perempuan yang mati tenggelam dan memikat laki-laki serta anak-anak ke kuburan airnya.
statement.en: The Rusalki, water nymphs of Slavic mythology, are often translated as "mermaid"; initially regarded as benevolent spirits of fertility and agriculture, they gained a more sinister description in the 1800s as ghosts of women who died by drowning, luring men and children to their watery graves.

quote: Female merrows, with their beauty and long green hair, resemble our traditional views of mermaids. Their counterpart, the male merrow is considered grotesque, cruel and more fish than man.

statement.id: Merrow betina, dengan kecantikan dan rambut hijau panjang, menyerupai gambaran tradisional putri duyung; pasangan jantannya dianggap menyeramkan, kejam, dan lebih mirip ikan daripada manusia.
statement.en: Female merrows, with their beauty and long green hair, resemble traditional views of mermaids; their male counterpart is considered grotesque, cruel and more fish than man.

quote: These shape-shifting creatures live as seals while in the sea and transform into humans while on land.

statement.id: Selkie Skotlandia, yang sering dikaitkan dengan mitologi putri duyung, hidup sebagai anjing laut di laut dan berubah menjadi manusia di darat.
statement.en: The Scottish selkie, often connected to mermaid mythology, lives as a seal in the sea and transforms into a human on land.

quote: A feminine spirit found in many medieval European folktales, the Melusine has a serpent or fish's tail and sometimes has wings.

statement.id: Melusine adalah roh perempuan dalam banyak dongeng Eropa abad pertengahan yang berekor ular atau ikan dan kadang bersayap.
statement.en: Melusine is a feminine spirit found in many medieval European folktales who has a serpent or fish's tail and sometimes has wings.

quote: One of the earliest mermaid legends appeared in Syria around 1000 BC when the goddess Atargatis dove into a lake to take the form of a fish. As the gods there would not allow her to give up her great beauty, only her bottom half became a fish, and she kept her top half in human form.
locator: What are the origins of mermaids?

statement.id: Salah satu legenda putri duyung tertua muncul di Suriah sekitar 1000 SM, ketika dewi Atargatis terjun ke danau dan berwujud ikan; hanya bagian bawahnya menjadi ikan, sedangkan bagian atasnya tetap manusia.
statement.en: One of the earliest mermaid legends appeared in Syria around 1000 BC when the goddess Atargatis dove into a lake to take the form of a fish; only her bottom half became a fish, and she kept her top half in human form.

quote: The earliest depiction of a mermaid in England can be found in Norman chapel in Durham Castle, built around 1078 by Saxon stonemasons.
locator: What are the origins of mermaids?

statement.id: Penggambaran putri duyung tertua di Inggris ditemukan di kapel Norman di Kastil Durham, yang dibangun sekitar 1078 oleh tukang batu Saxon.
statement.en: The earliest depiction of a mermaid in England can be found in the Norman chapel in Durham Castle, built around 1078 by Saxon stonemasons.

quote: The Havfrue, or Mermaid, is represented in the popular tradition sometimes as a good, at other times as an evil and treacherous being. She is beautiful in her appearance.

statement.id: Havfrue, atau putri duyung, dalam tradisi rakyat digambarkan kadang sebagai makhluk baik dan kadang sebagai makhluk jahat dan licik; ia cantik rupanya.
statement.en: The Havfrue, or Mermaid, is represented in popular tradition sometimes as good, at other times as an evil and treacherous being; she is beautiful in her appearance.

quote: Fishermen sometimes see her in the bright summer's sun, when a thin mist hangs over the sea, sitting on the surface of the water, and combing her long golden hair with a golden comb, or driving up her snow-white cattle

statement.id: Nelayan kadang melihatnya di bawah matahari musim panas, duduk di permukaan air menyisir rambut emas panjangnya dengan sisir emas, atau menggiring ternak putih saljunya.
statement.en: Fishermen sometimes see her in the bright summer sun, sitting on the surface of the water combing her long golden hair with a golden comb, or driving up her snow-white cattle.

quote: Her appearance prognosticates both storm and ill success in their fishing. People that are drowned, and whose bodies are not found, are believed to be taken into the dwellings of the Mermaids.

statement.id: Kemunculannya menandakan badai dan kegagalan menangkap ikan; orang yang tenggelam dan jasadnya tidak ditemukan dipercaya dibawa ke tempat tinggal para putri duyung.
statement.en: Her appearance prognosticates both storm and ill success in fishing; drowned people whose bodies are not found are believed to be taken into the dwellings of the Mermaids.

quote: These beings are also supposed to have the power of foretelling future events. A Mermaid, we are told, prophesied the birth of Christian IV. of Denmark

statement.id: Makhluk-makhluk ini dipercaya mampu meramalkan peristiwa masa depan; seorang putri duyung konon meramalkan kelahiran Christian IV dari Denmark.
statement.en: These beings are also supposed to have the power of foretelling future events; a Mermaid is said to have prophesied the birth of Christian IV of Denmark.

quote: The Havmand, or Merman, is described as of a handsome form, with green or black hair and beard. He dwells either in the bottom of the sea, or in the cliffs and hills near the sea shore, and is regarded as rather a good and beneficent kind of being

statement.id: Havmand, atau manusia duyung, digambarkan berbentuk tampan dengan rambut dan janggut hijau atau hitam, tinggal di dasar laut atau di tebing dan bukit dekat pantai, dan dianggap makhluk yang cukup baik dan murah hati.
statement.en: The Havmand, or Merman, is described as handsome, with green or black hair and beard, dwelling at the bottom of the sea or in cliffs and hills near the shore, and is regarded as a rather good and beneficent kind of being.

quote: Near them he saw lying on the ground several seal-skins. As the man approached the dancers, all gave over their merriment, and flew like lightning to secure their garments; then clothing themselves, plunged in the form of seals into the sea.

statement.id: Dalam kisah "The Mermaid Wife" dari Shetland, seorang laki-laki melihat penghuni laut menari di pasir dengan kulit anjing laut tergeletak di dekat mereka; mereka bergegas memakai kulit itu dan terjun ke laut dalam wujud anjing laut.
statement.en: In the Shetland tale "The Mermaid Wife," a man saw sea-people dancing on the sand with seal-skins lying near them; they hurried to put on their garments and plunged into the sea in the form of seals.

quote: she never could hope to rejoin her family and friends below the waters, but must remain an unwilling inhabitant of the region enlightened by the sun.

statement.id: Tanpa kulit anjing lautnya, perempuan laut itu tidak dapat bergabung kembali dengan keluarganya di bawah air dan harus tetap tinggal di daratan.
statement.en: Without her seal-skin robe, the sea-maiden could not rejoin her family and friends below the waters and must remain an unwilling inhabitant of the region enlightened by the sun.

quote: But he only arrived in time to see his wife take the form of a seal, and from the ledge of a rock plunge into the sea.

statement.id: Setelah mendapatkan kembali kulitnya, sang istri berubah menjadi anjing laut dan terjun ke laut.
statement.en: After recovering her skin, the wife took the form of a seal and plunged into the sea.

quote: Thus the Lady of Gollerus resembles the Mermaid-wife and others which we have already related. Instead, however, of an entire dress, it is a kind of cap, named Cohuleen Driuth, without which she cannot return to her subaqueous abode.

statement.id: Nyonya Gollerus dari Irlandia menyerupai kisah istri putri duyung; alih-alih pakaian utuh, ia memiliki topi bernama Cohuleen Driuth, yang tanpanya ia tidak dapat kembali ke tempat tinggalnya di bawah air.
statement.en: The Lady of Gollerus of Ireland resembles the Mermaid-wife stories; instead of an entire dress it is a cap, named Cohuleen Driuth, without which she cannot return to her subaqueous abode.

quote: from coastal settlements in Ireland to the landlocked Karoo desert in South Africa

statement.id: Kisah putri duyung ditemukan dari permukiman pesisir di Irlandia hingga gurun Karoo di Afrika Selatan yang tidak berpantai.
statement.en: Mermaid stories are found from coastal settlements in Ireland to the landlocked Karoo desert in South Africa.

quote: At other times she comes as a beautiful maiden, chilled and shivering with the cold of the night, to the fires the fishers have kindled, hoping by this means to entice them to her love.

statement.id: Di lain waktu ia datang sebagai gadis cantik yang menggigil kedinginan ke api yang dinyalakan nelayan, berharap memikat mereka agar mencintainya.
statement.en: At other times she comes as a beautiful maiden, chilled and shivering with the cold of the night, to the fires the fishers have kindled, hoping to entice them to her love.

quote: It is a strange carving, with the mermaid found alongside two leopards and several hunting scenes.
locator: What are the origins of mermaids?

statement.id: Ukiran itu aneh: putri duyung ditemukan bersama dua macan tutul dan beberapa adegan berburu.
statement.en: It is a strange carving, with the mermaid found alongside two leopards and several hunting scenes.

quote: Many ancient Greek myths equate sirens with mermaids. However, while they share many characteristics, they are now seen as two different entities.
locator: Ancient Greece and Rome: Sirens and Mermaids

statement.id: Banyak mitos Yunani kuno menyamakan siren dengan putri duyung; walau banyak kesamaan, keduanya kini dipandang sebagai dua makhluk berbeda.
statement.en: Many ancient Greek myths equate sirens with mermaids; although they share many characteristics, they are now seen as two different entities.
